d: There's competition on and off the workshop floor in American Chopper. While Paul Sr. brings his competitive spirit to a lively volleyball game with the OCC crew, Paul Jr. and the fabrication team get to work on a custom bike for Dixie Chopper. Mower-inspired design details, powerful exhaust pipes and a stretched frame give the motorcycle its distinctive look, but unfinished assembly means the pressure is building. Enjoy the shop humour, family dynamics and hands-on craftsmanship that make this motorcycle reality show a favourite among fans of custom motorcycle builders.
